Randominder allows you to set time slots where you (don't) want to be reminded, over any range of days with the possibility to repeat reminders forever. Use Randominder to hack your routine and get into the habit of journaling, or to remind yourself to take breaks and drink water.

Don't want to be reminded on Tuesdays and Sundays? No problem! Filter weekdays to fit your schedule. Just set, forget and let Randominder take care of the rest.

Set up daily reminders with affirmations, or surprise yourself with a memo next month.

Connect reminders to Actions. Compose emails, phone calls, text messages, web searches and more. You can also link shortcuts (with optional input) to reminders. Tap a delivered notification to trigger the Action.

Schedule a list of reminders for more variety. When it's time to deliver a notification, its contents will be randomly selected from your group.

Setup is simple. Choose between Allow and Block mode. Allow a simple window for reminders to be delivered. Block times you don't want to be reminded. Set your sleep schedule to avoid being reminded at night.

Follow @randominder_app on Twitter for updates. Thanks for stopping by!
